triage.note: The run demonstrates what it claims and its residue is stated. 12 assertions: the Bessel generating function checked to 25 digits at four orders and two times, the continuum integral int_0^inf (4 pi t)^{-3/2} e^{-r^2/4t} dt = 1/(4 pi r) in closed form by sympy, G(0) against Watson's Gamma closed form to 9e-27, the tail 4 pi R G(R) at three inequivalent directions and three radii, the correction coefficient by Richardson at the same three directions, and two exact Taylor facts replacing a2's ASSUMED partial-fraction identity. What it establishes: the node's three asserted kernel properties are now verified from the kernel itself rather than cited - the on-site value exactly, the Newtonian tail from the heat-kernel representation plus the local limit theorem, and the 5/(32 pi) cubic-harmonic correction to 3e-6 from three values of K4 including two of opposite sign, which is what fixes the angular shape rather than merely matching on one ray. Candidate (iii) chi = 7/E inherits all three with one factor 7. NOT established, and section 3 says so: the local limit theorem for the continuous-time simple cubic walk is quoted, not proved with an explicit error term, so the import moves from 'the note says so' to 'a standard theorem says so and three directions agree'; the 5/(32 pi) is extrapolated, not derived, since the Fourier constant for the degree-4 cubic harmonic is not computed analytically; and nothing here revisits the node's reading or the other two candidates, which a3 and a2 - the latter from another machine - already agree on. Attempt a3 is by the same model family, machine and running worker as this one; that is disclosed in the attempt's first paragraph.
